name: Warner Music Group Corp.
sector: Communication Services / Music (Recorded Music & Music Publishing)
moat_justification: One of the three majors: an evergreen recorded-music catalog plus Warner Chappell publishing copyrights that have monetized every format shift, with demonstrated pricing power at the DSP table (FY2026 renewals delivered contractual per-subscriber minimum increases; Q3 FY2026 subscription streaming +12.5%). Returns support a real but not wide moat: roic_proxy in fundamentals.json ran 14.2% / 16.2% / 15.7% / 17.1% / 12.5% across FY2021-FY2025 and gross margin held ~46-48% for a decade — but the gross margin never expands (pricing gains are shared with artists and DSPs), WMG is the number-three major behind Universal and Sony, distribution belongs to the DSP gatekeepers, and the frontline stays hit-driven. That is moderate-strong, not 7+: a 6 gives CAP 9.8 years.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 13 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override

SHARES_FALLBACK: no diluted share count filed for 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019 — those history years use the basic / outstanding / dei count recorded in the shares_tag column; per-share history there is approximate

WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 4.8x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
one_liner: Durable catalog/publishing major, moat 6/10 - even on the stepped-up TTM base of $1.43/share it clears 15% only at ~$13.70 vs the $31.40 price (weighted IRR 8.14%, IV@15% $13.70, Tier D); even the super-bull case earns only 13.5%.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Evergreen recorded catalog + Warner Chappell publishing copyrights - long-lived scarce IP that monetizes every format shift (streaming, social, sync, AI licensing)
Proven DSP pricing power - FY2026 renewals carry contractual per-subscriber minimum increases; Q3 FY2026 subscription streaming revenue +12.5%
Returns through a cycle - ROIC proxy 14-17% FY2021-FY2024, 12.5% FY2025; gross margin ~46-48% for ten straight years (fundamentals.json)
Two-engine mix - Recorded Music $5,408M FY2025 plus steadier Music Publishing royalties $1,306M, with global A&R/marketing scale
moat_against: Distribution belongs to the DSPs - Spotify and peers control the customer relationship and take their cut before WMG
Number-three major - subscale vs Universal and Sony in catalog, market share and bargaining weight
Hit-driven frontline - depends on signing and retaining artists against rising advances/royalties, independents and AI-generated supply
Levered, controlled equity - net debt $3,531M (4.8x normalized OE), lease liabilities $243M, and a controlling holder in Access Industries
No gross-margin expansion in a decade (~46-48%) - industry pricing gains are split with artists and DSPs, capping OE margin at 7-9%
